relationships.subject: Astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: A potential mechanism underlying these effects is the anti-inflammatory action of astaxanthin, likely mediated through the inhibition of the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: Astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: The findings revealed that astaxanthin significantly ameliorated mechanical and thermal pain in mice with fibromyalgia

key_findings: Astaxanthin ameliorated mechanical and thermal pain, sleep disorder and depressive-like behaviour in fibromyalgia mice.
Effects were likely mediated through NLRP3 inflammasome inhibition.
